cases.question: why must fertilizer applications at ksc be selected carefully for sandy soil, and what factors determine the fertilizer analysis, rate, type, and timing of applicatoin?
cases.ground_truth: Because sandy soil rapidly leaches fertilizer due to rain and high temperatures; the Horticulturist chooses the analysis and rate based on plant or grass needs, soil deficiencies, desired maintenance level, and seasonal considerations.
